description: Use this when the user asks how tall the buildings are around an address or in a small area in France: height in metres per building, floors, main use, year built and ground altitude, from IGN BD TOPO. The area is a place with a radius (default 150 m) or a bbox, at most 0.6 km². Shows the buildings on a map with a height summary (count, median, tallest) and GeoJSON, KML, Shapefile zip or CSV downloads. France only (mainland, Corsica and overseas departments). Never use the user's current location unless they type it. Give the place as the user names it (place name, address or coordinates): this tool locates it, so find_places is not needed first. Download links build their file when opened; no file is saved. Never pass these links to open_gis_file: list every format the user needs in formats, in this one call.

area.description: The area: a bbox, or a place (name, address or coordinates) with an optional radius in metres. The place the user asks about, not the user's own location.

bbox.description: [west, south, east, north] in decimal degrees (WGS 84).

place.description: A place name or address, or a point.

radius_m.description: Radius around the place in metres.

name: french_building_heights

downloads.description: Download links; each builds its file when opened.

hint.description: What to do next, on errors only.

sources.description: Data sources and licences of the result.

title: French building heights
